tbesh_html:
A man of the Moabites living before Israel's Monarchy, first mentioned at Jdg.3.12
§ Eglon = "calf-like"
1) king of Moab who oppressed the children of Israel for 18 years before he was killed by the judge Ehud
2) a royal city in Canaan that opposed the conquest; located in the low lands of Judah

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Eglon, the name of a place in Palestine and of a Moabitish king
